info.title: Ivorovi Assessment Platform API
info.description: All endpoints require an OIDC bearer token. Errors use application/problem+json with a stable `code` and a `traceId`.

get.summary: Organization settings: unit-type display labels and time zone (all signed-in users)

put.summary: Update a staff profile (optimistic version required)
Set an organization-level (no orgUnitId) or university/college override (requires feature.manage in scope)

delete.summary: Remove an override so the value is inherited again

get.summary: List users visible to the caller (search, filters, sort, pagination)

post.summary: Create a user (status INVITED) with a primary organizational assignment; optionally email an invitation
Suspend, reactivate, deactivate or activate an account (also enables/disables the login)

get.summary: Role assignments of the user, including revoked and expired ones

post.summary: Assign a role at the organization or a unit (anti-escalation: you must hold its permissions there)
Revoke a role assignment (kept in history with the reason)
Assign the user to a unit (or the whole organization when orgUnitId is omitted)
Send or re-send the invitation email (a new link replaces the previous one)

get.summary: List staff profiles visible to the caller

post.summary: Create a staff profile (no login account required)
Link the profile to a user account
Public: describe an invitation for the acceptance page (token in the body, never in the URL)
Public: accept an invitation, creating the login with the chosen password

get.summary: List organization units visible to the caller (search, filters, sort, pagination)

post.summary: Create a unit (requires org_unit.manage on the parent; tenant-wide for top-level units)
Move a unit (and its subtree) under a new parent, or to the top level
Deactivate a unit (not allowed while it has active sub-units)
Activate a unit (its parent must be active)
Mark one of my notifications as read
Mark all my notifications as read
Revoke an open invitation; its link stops working immediately

get.summary: User details, including what the caller may do with the account

patch.summary: Edit profile fields (email only before the first sign-in)

get.summary: Unit details with ancestors (breadcrumb), child counts and dependents

delete.summary: Delete an unused unit (otherwise 409 org_unit_has_dependents: deactivate instead)

patch.summary: Edit code, name, short name, attributes or branding (optimistic version)

get.summary: Access overview: organizational assignments, roles and effective permissions by scope
System roles that can be assigned, with their permissions
Change history of a unit (newest first)
All visible units (flat, with parent ids) for building the hierarchy tree
Counts by type and status, and campuses/departments per institution (visible units)
List my notifications (newest first)
Number of my unread notifications
Current user, tenant (with branding) and effective scoped permissions
Invitations of users visible to the caller
Effective features for the organization, or for any unit (inherited down the hierarchy)
Feature configuration for the organization or a university/college (requires feature.read in scope)
Search the tenant audit trail (newest first)
Verify the integrity of the tenant's hash-chained audit trail
